responsibility: This definition module declares mc’s minimal internal debugging utilities: an assert primitive for invariants and a conditional debug-string writer. It is the small shared interface used by low-level support and compiler modules that need internal consistency checking without depending directly on the error-reporting implementation.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the exported interface for the mcDebug stem, declaring just assert and writeDebug; the same-named .mod file supplies their behavior by routing failed assertions to mcError and gating debug output on compiler options.
